Dialogs.Dialog: (Oh right！ Maybe I'll invite her on the Nikko-Kinugawa trip I won...)
Actually, I won a trip in a sweepstakes again.
No, no, not this time. Believe it or not...
A grown-up school trip: a two-day, one-night Nikko-Kinugawa hot spring tour!!
Well, we're not exactly "grown-ups" yet, but sounds kind of fun, right？
Yes... it really does sound fun.
No, that's not it！ It's just...
Let's go？ A school trip, just the two of us.
But you don't seem that into it, do you？
No. I want to go on the school trip. Yes... it sounds fun！
By the way... is it really okay？ You know... your dad.
It's fine, you know？ Because he already knows. That I went to Atami with you.
I see. No... wait a minute.
Well, I just don't like lying. I had Mama back me up and explained properly. And then he said he was "relieved."
Yes. "Looking at Manaka, I could tell nothing improper happened," he said.
"He seems like a fine young man, rare these days," he said.
Huh, really... your dad is surprisingly understanding！
"If he ever tries anything funny, call me," he said. "Wherever you are, I'll come running."
Hehe！ So, hey？ When are we going？
(Um, let's make the date some other day...)
Then from ▲月▲▲日▲, a two-day, one-night school trip！ Ah！ And nothing funny！
I don't think kissing counts... as something funny...
(Yes!! A school trip just for me and ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
(Oh right！ Maybe I'll invite her on the Nikko-Kinugawa trip I won again...)
Actually, I won it again, the grown-up school trip to Nikko-Kinugawa hot springs！
H-hey... but aren't you winning a little too often？
Hey, could it be that really, you...
No... either way, I'm happy. I want to go on the school trip. With you again.
All right！ Then, when should we go...
Um, putting dates aside for another day...
From ▲月▲▲日▲, a two-day, one-night school trip！
(Yes!! A school trip just for me and ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Sorry for calling out of the blue. Want to go to the shopping mall now to shop for the trip？
For the trip？ Do we need anything？
Well, it's a school trip, right？ I think there's lots we need.
I made a packing list. Here.
Oh, serious stuff. Let's see, um... motion sickness pills, wet wipes, trekking shoes, thick socks... cards？
Well, it's a school trip, right？ Don't you want to play at night together？
I see, that could be fun！
(Wait... we're going to Kinugawa hot springs, so there might be a family bath again...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, don't you need to buy a swimsuit？
Well, there might be a family bath again, like in Atami？
Okay！ Is that everything on the list？
Yes, that's everything. Pack early, okay？ Even if you prepare, if you rush the morning of, you'll forget something.
You sound like a teacher, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hehe！ Those who understand, please raise your hand.
Okaaay！ Then, shall we head home？
Ah, go ahead without me？ I still have something to buy.
Oh, there's more？ Then I'll come with you.
It's fine. It's really just some little things.
(Girls have all sorts of stuff, huh...)
Good morning. Nice weather, isn't it？
Morning. I hope it's sunny there too.
Yes, the forecast says it'll be fine during the trip. They said the fresh green leaves are at their best.
Good morning. It looks like it'll be hot today too.
Yeah. I wonder if it's a little cooler there？
It's still too early for the autumn leaves, but it seems mornings and evenings are colder than here.
Oh, you've done your homework, huh？
Yes. Well, you know, it's a school trip！
I see. Yeah, it's a school trip！
After this, we're taking the limited express, right？
Right, the Limited Express Kinu. We transfer to the Tobu Railway.
You've got the transfer info down too. As expected of ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Actually... I brought a trip guidebook.
Whoa！ Serious stuff... did ▲高嶺＊＊▲ make this？
Well, it's a school trip. I thought it'd be good to have one.
Yes！ I made another one. Here.
Whoa... it kind of looks like a bullet train？
It really is cool... The Spacia, the 100 series limited express. This one is purple, so it's the "Miyabi."
Spacia, huh, sounds fast. But looking up even the train cars, as expected of ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
No, that I just happened to know.
("Just happened to"... is not something most people know...)
Oh right. Did you bring a "trip guidebook" this time？
Hm？ Did you upgrade it a little？
Yes. I added a few things I learned on our last trip, and some photos.
If we keep adding to it like this, it becomes a record of our trips... ours.
The Limited Express Spacia... it really is exciting―― hm？ ...▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I can't see it after all...
I was wondering if I could see the bogies. There's something I wanted to check.
Mmm... a roomy car, big seats！ Limited expresses are great！
Hehe！ It really feels like we're setting off on a trip, doesn't it？
Yeah, yeah. Oh right, speaking of trips... that's a huge amount of luggage again, huh？
Yes... I left behind the "just in case" stuff, though.
So, a change of clothes... and what else？
Face wash, a brush, shampoo... and other stuff.
Can't you just use the inn's stuff？
I can't... if it's not stuff I'm used to, I get anxious...
Anxious？ Is that how it is？
Because... I want to look nice. Always, when we're together.
How nice... there's so much green outside the window.
Shouldn't we decide which of us is the teacher in charge？
The teacher in charge!? We have to decide that？
Well, it's more like a school trip with a teacher, right？
I guess... then ▲高嶺＊＊▲, who looks everything up, should be the teacher？
Hehe！ I'm counting on you, Sensei▼
(It was decided from the start, huh...)
Then this time ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s the teacher？
Because I want to call you "Sensei." Hey, okay？ Sensei▼
We will shortly be arriving at Kinugawa Onsen. Please make sure you don't leave anything behind...
That felt fast, huh？ All right, time to get ready to get off！
Yes... we're staying here tonight, right？
No, hearing you say it like that makes me kind of nervous...
Hehe, you're funny！ Hey, what's that？ An ogre？ Ah, there's a foot bath too！ Let's go？
Okay. But the river boat ride is soon, so let's leave our bags in the station lockers first. ...They're heavy.
Nice to see you again, Kinuta-san.
May I take a picture with Kinuta-san？
On school trips, you sure get hyped, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Thank you. The river boat ride... it's my first time.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, are you nervous？ Anyway, let's go down to the river.
Whoa... the current's pretty fast up ahead.
Hey, we're riding in that wooden boat, right？
Yeah. Oh, looks like boarding has started.
Yes. We're riding in that wooden boat, right？
It's fine！ Takane！ This is a group activity, come on, hurry！
Thank you. There's still time, but shall we head down early？
The water's so clear... the air really does taste better by the river.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s really different from the first time, huh？
Well, they explained the life jackets, so I imagined something like white-water rafting...
Sorry to keep you waiting！ We're now boarding！
H-hey... over there, it's kind of like a little waterfall...
Hey, did you see it？ Gorilla Rock！
Saw it, saw it！ A gorilla's profile, right？
Whoa... that one got me a little...
Yeah. Spotting the rocks is fun too.
How many did you get？ Gorilla Rock, right？ Elephant Rock, Dog Rock... Ghost Rock！
That one was kind of a stretch, though？
A little, right？ Haah... it's so cool and nice out on the river！
Salt-grilled sweetfish？ Nice, want to try some？
Is it a little bad manners？
It's wild, that's good, right？ We're here, after all.
When I came here in elementary school？ I really wanted to try it.
But the teacher would've scolded me, and it felt a little like bad manners...
So you held back. Then today, the teacher's eating one too, so Takane, you eat too！
Ah, looks like the bus is here！
All right, next we transfer buses to Tobu World Square！
The current seemed a little faster today than last time.
Maybe？ Ah, look, salt-grilled sweetfish. You're having some, right？
All right, Tobu World Square it is！
Tobu World Square, huh... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you came here on your elementary school trip, right？
Huh, you got quiet again... ah, are you carsick from the bus？
I'm fine. I just remembered something...
We stopped at Tobu World Square on the second day, but the night before, the night we stayed over...
Even after lights-out, everyone was making a racket and wouldn't sleep.
Well, that's what happens on school trips, right？
Right？ But I was so, so sleepy...
So I went to the teacher's room to ask if I could sleep there. And then the teacher went to scold everyone.
The next day, I ended up all alone...
So in the pictures I took then, neither my friends nor I are in them. Just close-ups of the models.
This is the Tobu World Square entrance. Passengers getting off, please make sure you don't leave anything behind...
"Where dreams and wonder meet." Tobu World Square, huh...
Let's take lots of pictures, okay？ This time, every one of them will have ▲高嶺＊＊▲ in it.
This is the Tobu World Square entrance. Passengers getting off, please make sure you don't leave anything behind...
"Where dreams and wonder meet." Tobu World Square...
Hehe, you seem to like that slogan, huh？
Sort of. Let's go meet dreams and wonder！
Whoa!? Amazing... a world at 1/25 scale.
Amazing, right？ The buildings are so detailed, but look closely――
The little people are doing all sorts of things. Did you notice？
They really are detailed. Okay, first... over there.
Amazing... the trains are moving too...
Yeah, right～... maybe lean in a little more, like you're peering down？
(Title: "Giant Manaka Attacks Tokyo Station！ People Flee in Terror")
Hm？ Nothing？ Let's check out the next one！
New York's skyscrapers are still huge, even like this...
Yes, even if I were a monster, I don't think I could knock them down.
Japan needs to step it up... ah, I got an idea！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, over there！
Reporters are gathered at the entrance. Ah, is that the Prime Minister？
Right, right. So, try raising your fist, like this？
(Title: "Giant Manaka Puts Pressure on the Diet！")
All right！ Let's check out the next one！
Some I don't know, but lots of them are famous！
The Palace of Versailles！ That's right, the gardens were so lovely I took a picture...
Hey, if you hold the camera close to the ground when you shoot, it looks really big, you know？
I see！ Then... that one！ The Eiffel Tower！
At 1/25 scale, it ends up this small, huh？
Ah, nice！ Try reaching your hand out toward the tower？
(Title: "Giant Manaka Attempts to Climb the Eiffel Tower")
Kyah！ What？ Why are you shooting from down there...
No, no！ It's not like that！
Man... Tobu World Square is fun！ It's like I went around the world！
Hehe！ I had so much fun too.
Because you're kind... I love you.
...Huh？ Oh... the bus is coming soon, right？ Next is EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura.
I see. Then on the bus. Hehe, I can't wait！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ won't get mad when she sees the pictures, will she...)
Man... this is fun after all！ I feel like I really met dreams and wonder！
Hehe, but they're all weird pictures.
Are they？ I think they're all masterpieces？
Thank you... for making this one of my favorite places.
This is the EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura entrance. Passengers getting off, please make sure you don't leave anything behind...
Whoa... we're here. This is it.
From here, you don't really get the wonderland vibe, though.
It looks a little stern... see, like a checkpoint.
Yeah. Do we give our tickets to that gatekeeper-looking guy？
Good traveler, dost thou have thy travel pass, de gozaru？
Ah, yes！ Two adults, um... de gozaru.
...Very well！ Then take care on thy way, de gozaru！
▲高嶺＊＊▲... did you just say "de gozaru"？
Well, I felt like it would be rude not to...
This is the EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura entrance. Passengers getting off, please make sure you don't leave anything behind...
EDO WONDERLAND... we've come again, de gozaru.
Y-yes... I'll go buy the tickets？
Yes... some are like sets, but there are real shops too, aren't there？
And the people walking around are all Edo townspeople. They really went all out...
Somehow, it was more... you know, than I expected...
Well, hehe！ Hey！ Let's go see the others, de gozaru！
Smells so good... ah, yakitori. Soba, and Kamameshi Matsumaeya...
Come to think of it, it's already past noon... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, hungry？
Yes, Sensei！ I'm hungry, de gozaru！
(Geez, what character is she even playing...)
Hey, did you see the menu？ It says "kare-udon." Hehe！
You're right. Um, Shogun Kamameshi... 1,800 ryo!? I'll get the "kare-udon."
Then I'll have... yes, the wild vegetable kamameshi！
That line is for... "The Ninja Crow Mansion," huh.
Amazing... even knowing there are tricks, you still get fooled... kyah！
That surprised me... a ninja's face was right in front of me...
Yeah. ...He got a little too close, though？
It's definitely because ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s so cute.
No way. It was just a coincidence. I'm plain.
(In ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s case, she probably means it...)
Ah, look！ Over there！ "The Ninja Weird House"！
You sure like ninja stuff... okay, let's go in――
What？ Why？ Eek, this is weird!!
Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ Don't run, it's dangerous！
See！ I told you it was dangerous――
(Huh？ We're alone, so could this be...)
(More than ninjas, she just really, really loves this kind of thing...)
The oiran procession is about to begin. Everyone, please enjoy the oiran's elegant parade！
I wonder what it feels like to parade like that, gathering admiring looks...
Would you like to try it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
No way！ I'd be so nervous, I couldn't... but...
So girls really do dream about that？
Because unless it's someone I truly love, um...
(Okay, I've looked through the souvenir shops... huh, where's ▲高嶺＊＊▲？)
Sorry to keep you waiting. Hey, look at this？
A phone strap？ Ah, there's a name...
They have our names on them. So... the "Manaka" one is yours, and...
Yes... a keepsake of today. ...Will you carry it？
Thank you too... for taking it...
That's a little embarrassing, huh？ Okay, the bus is coming, let's go！ Next, at last, the inn！
Haah！ We played so much again！
▲高嶺＊＊▲ always gets so into it when we come here, huh？
True. That's EDO WONDERLAND for you. The bus should be coming soon？
Yes. At last, the overnight stay, right？
Well, you know, like a "pillow fight"！ We're doing it again, right？
Ah！ Oh, that！ Oh, I see...
Huh... what were you talking about？
That, that！ Come on, let's go！
Come to think of it, I'm starving！
Okay, the bus to the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel is...
Sorry to keep you waiting. Guests staying at the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel！
We're here！ So this is tonight's lodging, the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel！
What a big hotel... and a big... ball？
Sorry to keep you waiting. I checked in. Dinner's at 7.
Thank you. Hey... this really is the place, right？ It's so fancy...
Thank you for waiting. I'll show you to your room. Madam, may I take your bags？
Huh!? Ah, um, we're, um, on a school trip――
Sorry to keep you waiting. Guests staying at the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel！
We're here！ The Kinugawa Plaza Hotel！
The big ball！ The Treasure Bath！
Sorry to keep you waiting. I've checked in. Dinner's at 7.
Thank you. It's so spacious... like an art museum...
Yeah. It threw me off a little the first time...
Thank you for waiting. I'll show you to your room. Madam, may I take your bags？
Huh!? Ah, yes！ Um, I-I'm fine！
Even though it's a school trip...
What a lovely room... it even has a dining area... ah, look outside！
There's an open-air bath... a bath looking down on the Kinugawa...
Ah, no... I was just saying it.
Geez... this room seems a little too luxurious for a school trip...
What a lovely room... you can see the Kinugawa so well, too.
The furniture's cool too, it's like a luxury apartment, huh？
Really, it even has a little sink. I guess you'd call it a condominium... more than a school trip, it's like...
Hm？ More than a school trip, it's like？
...I won't say. You know perfectly well, you're just being mean...
(What was she imagining... that's kind of embarrassing.)
Want to go to the big bath before dinner？
Then let's meet back here. Sorry if I take a while？
Girls take forever！ I'll have a drink while I wait.
It's huge～！ A full view of the Kinugawa！ This feels great～！
(Haah～, the day's fatigue is melting away... I'm getting sleepy...)
All right, time to get out！
That was close... I'd better really get out...
Hot spring trips really are great...
That was a nice bath, wasn't it？
Hehe, you took a long bath, huh？
Excuse me. I've come to set up your meal.
Hehe！ Is this okay, even though it's a school trip？
While we're in the room, let's call it a break, like a date――
I can't possibly finish it all, so please eat the meat.
Want to explore to help it digest？ Inside the hotel？
There's all sorts of stuff... local specialties, Utsunomiya gyoza, lots of local-only sweets...
Yeah, lots of stuff？ What about you？
As a tennis club member, I have to！
I give up... ▲高嶺＊＊▲ got all serious.
They call it table tennis, right？ I couldn't help getting serious. Hehe♪
I need to get better... ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s even wearing a yukata and all...
Let's head back to the room！
I'm all sweaty... maybe I'll take another bath.
Ah, then this time why don't we try the "Kitoutei"？ You know, the private bath in the annex！
A private bath means！ Could it be...
Oh, it has a nice charm to it！
It's really lovely... hey, let's go？
Hehe, it's like a bath in the forest, isn't it？
Then until we go back to the room, we're on break.
Okay, let me wash your back... Just kidding♪
Yes. Then, um... could you go out first？ I'll stay a bit longer.
If you soak too long, you'll get dizzy, you know？
Yes, but... I can't put my yukata on over a wet swimsuit...
Here we are, the Kitoutei. While we're here, the school trip is on a little break, right？
So luxurious！ Is this okay for high schoolers？
Really, hehe. Sit down, let me wash your back♪
You don't have to be shy！
It's not being shy, it's because... geez, it's fine！ Please sit down.
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting.
That was a nice bath, wasn't it？ Haah...
Geez, what？ Don't look so much...
Huh？ Oh, I was just thinking a yukata really suits you.
R-really... but you look better in yours.
Yes... it really suits you. Manly and lovely.
We're still on break, from the school trip pretend...
Hey, can I go buy a drink somewhere？
A drink？ Then I'm pretty sure the fridge has――
Then, once I've gone to buy one, come looking for me after？
She's not here... where did she go？
Not here either... where is she？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, where are you～...
How far did she go？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, where are you～...
No, you're supposed to say, "It's past lights-out！", Sensei？
I'm sorry！ I'll go right back！
(She's cute, so I'll let it slide...)
Okay. It's still a little early for bed―― ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what should we do？
Oh right, it's a school trip, huh？ But wasn't I the teacher？
Okay... I'll pay you back double！
Well, the beds, see... there are two.
So... I was wondering how we'll sleep...
No, even if you tell me to decide...
I want you to decide. Because saying it myself would be...
R-right. But... what do you want, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I... what I really want is...
Ah, you wanted the wall side too, didn't you？ Then I――
No, no... it's fine？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ can have the wall side...
(That was confusing... she had me going for a sec...)
Hehe, me too. Then I'll turn off the lights？
There was one more thing I wanted to do. On a school trip.
Shall we confess who we like？
The person I like... has a wonderful smile when he laughs,
he's actually really manly, and he teaches me lots of things I don't know...
(Somehow, I'm starting to feel like it's not me...)
He can be a little pervy, but he's really kind...
He's my doubles partner in the tennis club... that's all I'll tell you.
Yeah... let's see, the person I like is...
Haaah～～！ Time to go to bed！
Before that, there's still something, right？ You know, speaking of school trips...
Hehe, then get under the covers？
The person I like is... let's see...
Then, a hint. Is she in the same club？
Then, is she in the same class？
Ehh～, if I tell you that, you'll figure it out.
Then, what is M.T. good at？
Studying, sports？ She's the ace of the tennis club, and she's super cute！
Is that so... then how much do you like her？
More than anyone in the world.
(Good thing I got up early. I slept properly last night！)
(I'll let her sleep a little longer...)
You're sleeping so soundly～？ Sorry, but it's morning～？
If you don't get up, your nose gets... squish！ Hehe！
Still asleep... so cute▼ Then, take this！
▲高嶺＊＊▲... did you just do something？
Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s not here... what happened？
The bathroom？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲～？ You in there～？
Huh!? No, don't come in here！
Well, they said breakfast is ready. Hey, hurry up and change？
Wow, you can see the Kinugawa so well！ There's even terrace seating.
They have both Japanese and Western food！
Really, freshly baked bread, and ah, the Japanese food is "obanzai," it says！
Sorry to keep you waiting. I might have taken too much♪
Wow, you really took a lot！
Well, there were so many delicious-looking pickles... ah, look who's talking.
Hehe, today's Nikko, right？ We have to eat lots and do our best！
Thank you very much. We look forward to your next visit.
Okay, all set... sorry to keep you waiting, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
That was a great hotel, huh！ The Kinugawa Plaza Hotel.
Yes... I made so many memories. I hope we can come again？
If only I win again... oh right, let's take a picture as a keepsake？
All right！ Today, at last, it's Nikko！
Huff, huff... we have to transfer, right？
Right！ If we miss this one, we'll have to wait a long time！
(No matter how I look at it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ should be the teacher.)
Glad we made it. ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s trip guidebook is perfect, after all？
Thank you. ...Ah, it really is a two-car train.
At Shimo-Imaichi Station, they couple and uncouple cars. From here to Tobu-Nikko, it runs with just the front two cars.
It was written in the guidebook, right？ Hehe▼
Okay, we transfer at Shimo-Imaichi, then Tobu-Nikko Station, right？ Let's go？
Thank you for everything, Kinuta-san. See you again.
Yes, two cars. Hehe！ Let's get on？ The seats in back, so we can see Mt. Nantai better.
(No matter how I look at it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ should be the teacher.)
Yes, Mt. Nantai！ It looks so close...
It looks taller than I thought... I think the guidebook had the elevation――
Mt. Nantai, beloved as "Nikko Fuji," has an elevation of 2,486m, revised in 2003. Even from Nikko city, it's over 1,200m higher.
First climbed by the monk Shodo Shonin in 782, it is also the sacred body of Futarasan Shrine. Ahem. Praise me, Sensei？ ...Just kidding.
Yes！ Doesn't the air feel a little colder than Kinugawa？
Maybe？ Um, the bus stop is――
Before that, we'll leave our bags in a locker.
I see！ As expected of Takane Tours！
Yes. I wonder what face it will show us today...
You sound kind of like a poet？
We're here！ Okay, let's drop off our bags and get the bus... ah. Are you okay with the bus？
I'm fine now. I took motion sickness medicine, and besides――
You'll look for them with me again, right？ I-ro-ha？
Of course. All right, let's go！
Irohazaka by bus... nervous after all？
I'm fine. I'm looking forward to Irohazaka？
Whoa... Irohazaka, all right. Curves, curves, curves...
Okay, let's read the letters on the signs at the curves！
The last one was "wo," right？ So next is...
Oh！ Then, Takane. Recite the whole thing from the beginning.
"Though colors are fragrant, they scatter; in our world, who lasts forever？ Crossing today the deep mountains of change, I'll dream no shallow dreams, nor be drunk."
Right, right. That was it, that was it, yep.
Hehe, geez！ Ah, look！ Isn't that "ka"？
Um... ah, there it is！ Looks like it's from over there.
Huh, we go down by elevator.
Right. We're at the top of the falls here. Let's go？
Listen, you can already hear it!!
We came all the way to Nikko, the two of us...
Um, one of Japan's three great waterfalls, Kegon Falls flows from Lake Chuzenji and drops 97m―― ah, look！
Sorry, um, a drop of 97m, and――
It's fine. Let's just watch it like this for a while.
Haah... coming here, it really sinks in, doesn't it？
Hey, have you noticed there are lots of lovely things around Kegon Falls？
Like the little falls around it？
Those are the Twelve Falls. And the Nehan Falls you can see below, right？ And...
？ You mean the rock that looks like pillars？
Yes, those are columnar joints！ They form when magma cools and hardens and its volume shrinks.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲... sometimes I can't keep up...)
Yes... so vast... look, over there.
Ah, a mountain like Mt. Fuji...
That's Mt. Nantai, you know？ It looks completely different from how it looked from the train. It really is like Mt. Fuji.
Apparently Lake Chuzenji is a dammed lake formed when Mt. Nantai erupted.
That was 20,000 years ago. This huge Lake Chuzenji, and Senjogahara, which you can't see from here――
This scenery was made over such a long, long time...
Yeah, thinking of it that way makes it feel like a luxury...
It's hard to believe this calm lake was made by Mt. Nantai erupting.
Yes. It took a mind-bogglingly long time...
Compared to that, our lifetimes are over in a flash...
I want to be with you forever, even one second longer...
Did you get a little carsick after all？
No, I'm fine... um, that was "ke" just now, so next is――
Yes. But... can we stay like this, just a little...？
Nikko Bussan Shokai. We're having lunch here, but... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, are you okay？
Yes, I'm fine. I might not be able to eat much... but let's go in？
